title: Kestrel and the Postcard
author: Jonah Dravenmoor
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
